title: The tolerance bands
description: How close an implementation must come, keyed by field and by what class of ephemeris it is using. One file for the whole corpus: a tolerance written beside a fixture is a tolerance that was widened to make that fixture pass.

status.description: `provisional` until the bands have been measured against real runs; a consumer may report against a provisional band but should not claim conformance to it.

provider_classes.description: What class of ephemeris a run used, because a band that is generous to a low-precision source would be meaningless for a high-precision one.

edge_policy.description: What to do at a boundary, where two implementations may legitimately fall on either side of a classification.

fields.description: Keyed by field path or pattern; a field not listed is compared exactly.
